raw_text: Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only; add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file; make all classes final unless inheritance is required; use readonly properties wherever possible, constructor property promotion, typed properties and return types; follow PSR-12. Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code. Base: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`; Data: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Data`; Requests: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Requests`; Enums: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Enums`. DTOs are `final readonly`; requests extend `Saloon\Http\Request` and are `final`; enums are backed enums with string or int values. Use traits for shared functionality (see `Traits/` directory); implement `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`. Member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth` trait. Add the `RequiresMemberAuth` trait to any request class that: Uses POST, PUT, or DELETE methods; Accesses member-specific data; Modifies DOI records. Use `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`. `DataCite.php` is the main client entry point. Requests/ contains Saloon request classes organized by API endpoint; Data/ contains DTOs for API responses. All responses should be typed using Data DTOs. Follow existing naming conventions in Data/ classes. Use typed arrays in DocBlocks: `<REDACTED_USER> DoiObject[]`. Run these commands before committing: `composer test`; `composer lint`; `composer test:unit`; `composer test:types`; `composer refactor`.
